newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion buys apartments for $76 mln.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion buys apartments for $76 mln.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said Friday it had acquired four apartment communities in two separate transactions worth a combined total of more than $70 million.
The company said it paid $17.25 million bought The Club at Hickory Hollow, a garden apartment community in the southeast of Nashville, containing 406 apartment homes.

It said it also exercised an option that was granted at the closing of a portfolio acquired in August 1996 to purchase three additional garden apartment communities containing 1,160 homes in North Carolina for about $59 million.
Part of the amount included two loans totalling $22 million at a weighted average interest rate of 8.4 percent, it said.
